FN-SFIS578-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 108
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Chris Pringle
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/04/2025
House Bill 108 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Board of Examiners
for Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology until October 1, 2029 pursuant to the Alabama
Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
